plugins.name: data-cleanroom
plugins.description: Turns messy CSV/TSV/JSON files into a typed, queryable SQLite warehouse plus a data-quality report — deterministic parsing, reproducible type inference, versioned recipes, sha256 provenance, a quarantine for every row that will not coerce, and idempotent reloads
plugins.author: BahulamAI

plugins.name: excalidraw-spec
plugins.description: Scans a repository, draws its architecture from real parsed imports, and exports it as a genuine .excalidraw document, a Mermaid diagram or an onboarding spec — the agent names the layers, the scanner supplies the evidence
plugins.author: BahulamAI

plugins.name: flashcards
plugins.description: Flashcards from a document or a topic, with an SM-2 review schedule — due dates, ease factors and review history in declared SQLite tables, plus a live study console
plugins.author: BahulamAI

plugins.name: hello-mcp
